searchText: Is the launch still planned for today/tomorrow ? I think it will better to have the test before <@412614104222531604> to be sure we dont have more issue Which test exactly do whe need for this I just see a bad block error but no indication of what went wrong exactly I had food poisioning yesterday and am still not 100% so I will get everything ready today and do some more testing will update regarding launch EOD The error that was found by Barnabas . You can see it on Besu Steel I remember correctly. I think it was a devnet with Besu and Nethermind yes were you able to repro? Didn't tried I was waiting for a testcase Ok thanks So current status: besu and nethermind are doing well against evm-fuzz and eoa tx testing geth is still having some EIP-7778 gas accounting issues nimbus-el still activates EIP-8024 too early fulu reth is missing blocks for both eoa and evm-fuzz tests It would be great to have one more stable client under eoa and evm-fuzzing tests before launching devnet-2. <@427903869226582018> <@902806914252021830> <@880461889509941258> I've pushed a fix for 7778 and Geth now interops with Besu before and after the fork when I've tested it locally with Kurtosis I am still working on integrating "batch io" (parallelizing loading of read storage slots and accounts with tx execution and state root calculation) This is for devnet 3 scope, right? I thought we agreed to include it on devnet 2 unfortunately there's a chainsplit between geth and besu 🙃 I thought devnet 3 was strictly BAL optimizations (with flags) and devnet 2 was BALs + the 4 new EIPs the bal devnet2 markdown doc from pandaops has a section on the performance feature flags: https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/bal-devnet-2#Client-BAL-features
